name: FDG-PET-CT-Lesions (autoPET), TCIA through NBIA
what: TCIA collection FDG-PET-CT-Lesions (autoPET; doi:10.7937/gkr0-xv29), which IDC v24 does not hold, fetched through NBIA; tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 900 subjects and the 900 CT series of their whole-body PET/CT studies, 509,282 DICOM instances, about 250.6 GB in the source's catalogue; the same Tuebingen people appear in PanTSMini and may appear in ENHANCE.PET 1.6k (scidb_enhance_pet_1_6k)
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: not recorded: the fetch took the 900 CT series alone (509,282 DICOM files, the CT's own count), so the lesion masks the collection publishes are not on the grid
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh nbia --collection tcia_fdg_pet_ct_lesions --manifest manifests/nbia_fdg_pet_ct_lesions.csv, submitted from the harvest's acquisition folder; the check is FETCH_STATUS.json's unresolved_failures at 0, and, by the manifest's note, 900 series / 509,282 instances to verify.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid tcia_fdg_pet_ct_lesions; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="tcia_fdg_pet_ct_lesions",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
